sloka: उद्धूतेन च वस्त्रेण तस्याः पीतेन रावणः ।अधिकम् परिबभ्राज गिरिः दीप इव अग्निना ॥३-५२-१५॥
transliteration: uddhūtena ca vastreṇa tasyāḥ pītena rāvaṇaḥ ।adhikam paribabhrāja giriḥ dīpa iva agninā ॥3-52-15॥

translations.english: Ravana was shining all the more with(her) yellow clothes blowing in the air, and looked like a mountain shining with fire burning around.
